question: What was the mascot of the FIH Men's Hockey World Cup 2023 held in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Olly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Olly** was the official mascot of the **FIH Men’s Hockey World Cup 2023**, held in **India.**
 
• The mascot **Olly** represents the **Olive Ridley turtles**, which are a species of sea turtles found along the eastern coast of India, specifically in Odisha.
 
• The **Olive Ridley turtles** are famous for their mass nesting phenomenon called **Arribada**, which occurs primarily at beaches like Gahirmatha and Rushikulya in Odisha.
 
• The selection of **Olly** as the mascot highlights the **importance of conservation** and the rich biodiversity of Odisha.
 
• The Hockey World Cup 2023 was hosted by the **Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar** and the **Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium in Rourkela**, Odisha.
 
• The mascot aimed to create awareness about **environmental issues** and promote sustainable practices alongside the spirit of the sport.
 
• Odisha has been a strong supporter of hockey and has hosted multiple international tournaments, making it a fitting venue for the World Cup.
